name: memory-kit
description: Persistent memory for your agent as plain files in your folder: a hot cache injected every session and held under three size caps, per-session handoffs, and promotion into knowledge articles and rules only on your yes. Carries the builder's layers too — executor/recon/idea-validator agents, session review, second opinion, agent QA and a system audit — all lazy-loaded skills you only pay for on use. Installs into any existing repository.
